title: The most expensive transfers ever
brief: Name the players in the ten most expensive transfers since July 2000, ranked by the guaranteed fee in euros reported at the time. Enzo Fernandez is in it twice.
period: Transfers from July 2000 to the end of the summer 2026 window (1 September 2026), any club. Guaranteed fee in euros as reported at the time; add-ons left out. Fees agreed in pounds are converted at the rate of the day, as in Wikipedia's list.

notes.Antoine Griezmann: Antoine Griezmann is 11th, just outside: €120m buyout clause, Atletico Madrid to Barcelona in 2019.
notes.Philippe Coutinho: Philippe Coutinho is 12th, just outside: €120m fixed (about €118.4m at the day's rate) plus €40m add-ons, Liverpool to Barcelona in 2018.
notes.Ousmane Dembele: Ousmane Dembele is outside the ten on the guaranteed fee: €105m plus €40m add-ons, Dortmund to Barcelona in 2017 (Transfermarkt counts €148m with add-ons).
notes.Jude Bellingham: Jude Bellingham is outside the ten on the guaranteed fee: €103m plus up to €31m add-ons, Dortmund to Real Madrid in 2023.
notes.Jack Grealish: Jack Grealish is outside the ten: £100m (€117.7m), Aston Villa to Manchester City in 2021.
notes.Florian Wirtz: Florian Wirtz is outside the ten: initial £100m (€117.5m) plus £16m add-ons, Leverkusen to Liverpool in 2025.
notes.Declan Rice: Declan Rice is outside the ten: initial £100m (€116.5m), West Ham to Arsenal in 2023.
notes.Moises Caicedo: Moises Caicedo is outside the ten: initial £100m (€116.3m), Brighton to Chelsea in 2023.
notes.Eden Hazard: Eden Hazard is outside the ten on the guaranteed fee: initial £89m (€100m), Chelsea to Real Madrid in 2019.
notes.Cristiano Ronaldo: Cristiano Ronaldo is outside the ten: €100m, Real Madrid to Juventus in 2018.

checks: Every row agrees between Wikipedia's list of most expensive transfers (updated 1 September 2026, each fee cited to BBC, Sky or The Athletic) and Transfermarkt's all-time record list, and each 2026 fee was checked again in a news report. Transfermarkt's figures include add-ons, so its order differs (it puts Dembele 3rd and Coutinho 8th); this board uses the guaranteed fee. The two £125m deals (Enzo Fernandez to City, Isak) are equal in pounds and only differ in euros because of the exchange rate.
